edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: How she sits alone, the city once full of people! She has become like a widow, she who was great among the nations. A princess among the provinces has become subject to forced labor.
verses.hebrew: אֵיכָה יָשְׁבָה בָדָד הָעִיר רַבָּתִי עָם הָיְתָה כְּאַלְמָנָה רַּבָּתִי בַגּוֹיִם שָׂרָתִי בַּמְּדִינוֹת הָיְתָה לָמַס׃

verses.english: She weeps bitterly in the night, her tears upon her cheek. Among all her lovers she has no comforter. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.
verses.hebrew: בָּכוֹ תִבְכֶּה בַּלַּיְלָה וְדִמְעָתָהּ עַל לֶחֱיָהּ אֵין־לָהּ מְנַחֵם מִכָּל־אֹהֲבֶיהָ כָּל־רֵעֶיהָ בָּגְדוּ בָהּ הָיוּ לָהּ לְאֹיְבִים׃

verses.english: Judah has gone into exile because of affliction and great servitude. She dwells among the nations; she has found no rest. All her pursuers overtook her in the narrow places.
verses.hebrew: גָּלְתָה יְהוּדָה מֵעֹנִי וּמֵרֹב עֲבֹדָה הִיא יָשְׁבָה בַגּוֹיִם לֹא מָצְאָה מָנוֹחַ כָּל־רֹדְפֶיהָ הִשִּׂיגוּהָ בֵּין הַמְּצָרִים׃

verses.english: Zion's roads mourn, for no one comes to the appointed festival. All her gates are desolate; her priests groan. Her virgins grieve, and she is bitter within.
verses.hebrew: דַּרְכֵי צִיּוֹן אֲבֵלוֹת מִבְּלִי בָּאֵי מוֹעֵד כָּל־שְׁעָרֶיהָ שׁוֹמֵמִין כֹּהֲנֶיהָ נֶאֱנָחִים בְּתוּלֹתֶיהָ נּוּגוֹת וְהִיא מַר־לָהּ׃

verses.english: Her adversaries have become the head; her enemies are at ease, for YHWH has afflicted her because of her many transgressions. Her little ones have gone captive before the adversary.
verses.hebrew: הָיוּ צָרֶיהָ לְרֹאשׁ אֹיְבֶיהָ שָׁלוּ כִּי־יְהוָה הוֹגָהּ עַל רֹב־פְּשָׁעֶיהָ עוֹלָלֶיהָ הָלְכוּ שְׁבִי לִפְנֵי־צָר׃

verses.english: All her splendor has departed from Daughter Zion. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture; they went without strength before the pursuer.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מן־בת־[מִבַּת־] צִיּוֹן כָּל־הֲדָרָהּ הָיוּ שָׂרֶיהָ כְּאַיָּלִים לֹא־מָצְאוּ מִרְעֶה וַיֵּלְכוּ בְלֹא־כֹחַ לִפְנֵי רוֹדֵף׃

verses.english: Jerusalem remembers, in the days of her affliction and wandering, all her precious things from days of old. When her people fell into the adversary's hand and no one helped her, her adversaries saw her and laughed at her downfall.
verses.hebrew: זָכְרָה יְרוּשָׁלִַם יְמֵי עָנְיָהּ וּמְרוּדֶיהָ כֹּל מַחֲמֻדֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ מִימֵי קֶדֶם בִּנְפֹל עַמָּהּ בְּיַד־צָר וְאֵין עוֹזֵר לָהּ רָאוּהָ צָרִים שָׂחֲקוּ עַל מִשְׁבַּתֶּהָ׃

verses.english: Jerusalem has sinned grievously; therefore she has become an unclean thing. All who honored her despise her, for they have seen her nakedness. She too groans and turns backward.
verses.hebrew: חֵטְא חָטְאָה יְרוּשָׁלִַם עַל־כֵּן לְנִידָה הָיָתָה כָּל־מְכַבְּדֶיהָ הִזִּילוּהָ כִּי־רָאוּ עֶרְוָתָהּ גַּם־הִיא נֶאֶנְחָה וַתָּשָׁב אָחוֹר׃

verses.english: Her uncleanness is in her skirts; she did not remember her end. She fell astonishingly; she has no comforter. See, YHWH, my affliction, for the enemy has made himself great!
verses.hebrew: טֻמְאָתָהּ בְּשׁוּלֶיהָ לֹא זָכְרָה אַחֲרִיתָהּ וַתֵּרֶד פְּלָאִים אֵין מְנַחֵם לָהּ רְאֵה יְהוָה אֶת־עָנְיִי כִּי הִגְדִּיל אוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: The adversary stretched out his hand over all her precious things. She saw nations enter her sanctuary, those whom You commanded not to enter Your assembly.
verses.hebrew: יָדוֹ פָּרַשׂ צָר עַל כָּל־מַחֲמַדֶּיהָ כִּי־רָאֲתָה גוֹיִם בָּאוּ מִקְדָּשָׁהּ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָה לֹא־יָבֹאוּ בַקָּהָל לָךְ׃

verses.english: All her people groan, seeking bread. They give their precious things for food to restore life. See, YHWH, and look, for I have become despised!
verses.hebrew: כָּל־עַמָּהּ נֶאֱנָחִים מְבַקְּשִׁים לֶחֶם נָתְנוּ מחמודיהם [מַחֲמַדֵּיהֶם] בְּאֹכֶל לְהָשִׁיב נָפֶשׁ רְאֵה יְהוָה וְהַבִּיטָה כִּי הָיִיתִי זוֹלֵלָה׃

verses.english: May it not come upon you, all who pass along the road! Look and see whether there is pain like my pain, which was dealt to me, with which YHWH afflicted me on the day of His burning anger.
verses.hebrew: לוֹא אֲלֵיכֶם כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דֶרֶךְ הַבִּיטוּ וּרְאוּ אִם־יֵשׁ מַכְאוֹב כְּמַכְאֹבִי אֲשֶׁר עוֹלַל לִי אֲשֶׁר הוֹגָה יְהוָה בְּיוֹם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: From on high He sent fire into my bones, and it mastered them. He spread a net for my feet; He turned me backward. He made me desolate, faint all day long.
verses.hebrew: מִמָּרוֹם שָׁלַח־אֵשׁ בְּעַצְמֹתַי וַיִּרְדֶּנָּה פָּרַשׂ רֶשֶׁת לְרַגְלַי הֱשִׁיבַנִי אָחוֹר נְתָנַנִי שֹׁמֵמָה כָּל־הַיּוֹם דָּוָה׃

verses.english: The yoke of my transgressions was bound by His hand; they were intertwined and rose upon my neck. He caused my strength to fail; the Lord gave me into hands I cannot withstand.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׂקַד עֹל פְּשָׁעַי בְּיָדוֹ יִשְׂתָּרְגוּ עָלוּ עַל־צַוָּארִי הִכְשִׁיל כֹּחִי נְתָנַנִי אֲדֹנָי בִּידֵי לֹא־אוּכַל קוּם׃

verses.english: The Lord rejected all my mighty men within me. He called an assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord trod a winepress for the virgin Daughter Judah.
verses.hebrew: סִלָּה כָל־אַבִּירַי אֲדֹנָי בְּקִרְבִּי קָרָא עָלַי מוֹעֵד לִשְׁבֹּר בַּחוּרָי גַּת דָּרַךְ אֲדֹנָי לִבְתוּלַת בַּת־יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: For these things I weep; my eye, my eye runs with water, for a comforter who could restore my life is far from me. My children have become desolate, for the enemy has prevailed.
verses.hebrew: עַל־אֵלֶּה אֲנִי בוֹכִיָּה עֵינִי עֵינִי יֹרְדָה מַּיִם כִּי־רָחַק מִמֶּנִּי מְנַחֵם מֵשִׁיב נַפְשִׁי הָיוּ בָנַי שׁוֹמֵמִים כִּי גָבַר אוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: Zion spreads out her hands; she has no comforter. YHWH commanded concerning Jacob that those around him be his adversaries. Jerusalem has become like a menstruating woman among them.
verses.hebrew: פֵּרְשָׂה צִיּוֹן בְּיָדֶיהָ אֵין מְנַחֵם לָהּ צִוָּה יְהוָה לְיַעֲקֹב סְבִיבָיו צָרָיו הָיְתָה יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְנִדָּה בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH is righteous, for I rebelled against His command. Hear, please, all you peoples, and see my pain. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק הוּא יְהוָה כִּי פִיהוּ מָרִיתִי שִׁמְעוּ־נָא כָל־עמים [הָעַמִּים] וּרְאוּ מַכְאֹבִי בְּתוּלֹתַי וּבַחוּרַי הָלְכוּ בַשֶּׁבִי׃

verses.english: I called to my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders expired in the city as they sought food for themselves to restore their lives.
verses.hebrew: קָרָאתִי לַמְאַהֲבַי הֵמָּה רִמּוּנִי כֹּהֲנַי וּזְקֵנַי בָּעִיר גָּוָעוּ כִּי־בִקְשׁוּ אֹכֶל לָמוֹ וְיָשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נַפְשָׁם׃

verses.english: See, YHWH, how distressed I am! My inward parts churn; my heart is overturned within me, for I have rebelled grievously. Outside the sword bereaves; inside it is like death.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה יְהוָה כִּי־צַר־לִי מֵעַי חֳמַרְמָרוּ נֶהְפַּךְ לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי כִּי מָרוֹ מָרִיתִי מִחוּץ שִׁכְּלָה־חֶרֶב בַּבַּיִת כַּמָּוֶת׃

verses.english: They heard that I groan; I have no comforter. All my enemies heard of my trouble; they rejoiced because You did it. You have brought the day You proclaimed; let them become like me!
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְעוּ כִּי נֶאֱנָחָה אָנִי אֵין מְנַחֵם לִי כָּל־אֹיְבַי שָׁמְעוּ רָעָתִי שָׂשׂוּ כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ הֵבֵאתָ יוֹם־קָרָאתָ וְיִהְיוּ כָמוֹנִי׃

verses.english: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You dealt with me for all my transgressions; for my groans are many and my heart is faint.
verses.hebrew: תָּבֹא כָל־רָעָתָם לְפָנֶיךָ וְעוֹלֵל לָמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עוֹלַלְתָּ לִי עַל כָּל־פְּשָׁעָי כִּי־רַבּוֹת אַנְחֹתַי וְלִבִּי דַוָּי׃

verses.english: How the Lord has covered Daughter Zion with a cloud in His anger! He cast Israel's splendor from heaven to earth and did not remember His footstool on the day of His anger.
verses.hebrew: אֵיכָה יָעִיב בְּאַפּוֹ אֲדֹנָי אֶת־בַּת־צִיּוֹן הִשְׁלִיךְ מִשָּׁמַיִם אֶרֶץ תִּפְאֶרֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־זָכַר הֲדֹם־רַגְלָיו בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: The Lord swallowed up without pity all Jacob's dwellings. In His fury He tore down Daughter Judah's fortresses; He brought them to the ground and profaned the kingdom and its princes.
verses.hebrew: בִּלַּע אֲדֹנָי לא [וְלֹא] חָמַל אֵת כָּל־נְאוֹת יַעֲקֹב הָרַס בְּעֶבְרָתוֹ מִבְצְרֵי בַת־יְהוּדָה הִגִּיעַ לָאָרֶץ חִלֵּל מַמְלָכָה וְשָׂרֶיהָ׃

verses.english: In burning anger He cut off every horn of Israel. He drew back His right hand before the enemy and burned in Jacob like a flaming fire consuming all around.
verses.hebrew: גָּדַע בָּחֳרִי אַף כֹּל קֶרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵשִׁיב אָחוֹר יְמִינוֹ מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב וַיִּבְעַר בְּיַעֲקֹב כְּאֵשׁ לֶהָבָה אָכְלָה סָבִיב׃

verses.english: He bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand stood firm like an adversary. He killed everything delightful to the eye; in Daughter Zion's tent He poured out His wrath like fire.
verses.hebrew: דָּרַךְ קַשְׁתּוֹ כְּאוֹיֵב נִצָּב יְמִינוֹ כְּצָר וַיַּהֲרֹג כֹּל מַחֲמַדֵּי־עָיִן בְּאֹהֶל בַּת־צִיּוֹן שָׁפַךְ כָּאֵשׁ חֲמָתוֹ׃

verses.english: The Lord has become like an enemy; He swallowed up Israel. He swallowed all her palaces and destroyed his fortresses; He multiplied mourning and lamentation in Daughter Judah.
verses.hebrew: הָיָה אֲדֹנָי כְּאוֹיֵב בִּלַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּלַּע כָּל־אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ שִׁחֵת מִבְצָרָיו וַיֶּרֶב בְּבַת־יְהוּדָה תַּאֲנִיָּה וַאֲנִיָּה׃

verses.english: He tore down His shelter like a garden and destroyed His meeting place. YHWH caused festival and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion; in His angry indignation He spurned king and priest.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְמֹס כַּגַּן שֻׂכּוֹ שִׁחֵת מוֹעֲדוֹ שִׁכַּח יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן מוֹעֵד וְשַׁבָּת וַיִּנְאַץ בְּזַעַם־אַפּוֹ מֶלֶךְ וְכֹהֵן׃

verses.english: The Lord rejected His altar and repudiated His sanctuary. He delivered the walls of her palaces into the enemy's hand. They raised a shout in YHWH's house as on a festival day.
verses.hebrew: זָנַח אֲדֹנָי מִזְבְּחוֹ נִאֵר מִקְדָּשׁוֹ הִסְגִּיר בְּיַד־אוֹיֵב חוֹמֹת אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ קוֹל נָתְנוּ בְּבֵית־יְהוָה כְּיוֹם מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: YHWH planned to destroy Daughter Zion's wall. He stretched out a line; He did not withdraw His hand from swallowing. He made rampart and wall mourn; together they languished.
verses.hebrew: חָשַׁב יְהוָה לְהַשְׁחִית חוֹמַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן נָטָה קָו לֹא־הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ מִבַּלֵּעַ וַיַּאֲבֶל־חֵל וְחוֹמָה יַחְדָּו אֻמְלָלוּ׃

verses.english: Her gates sank into the earth; He destroyed and broke her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations; there is no instruction. Even her prophets find no vision from YHWH.
verses.hebrew: טָבְעוּ בָאָרֶץ שְׁעָרֶיהָ אִבַּד וְשִׁבַּר בְּרִיחֶיהָ מַלְכָּהּ וְשָׂרֶיהָ בַגּוֹיִם אֵין תּוֹרָה גַּם־נְבִיאֶיהָ לֹא־מָצְאוּ חָזוֹן מֵיְהוָה׃

verses.english: Daughter Zion's elders sit on the ground in silence. They put dust on their heads and gird themselves with sackcloth. Jerusalem's virgins lower their heads to the ground.
verses.hebrew: יֵשְׁבוּ לָאָרֶץ יִדְּמוּ זִקְנֵי בַת־צִיּוֹן הֶעֱלוּ עָפָר עַל־רֹאשָׁם חָגְרוּ שַׂקִּים הוֹרִידוּ לָאָרֶץ רֹאשָׁן בְּתוּלֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: My eyes fail with tears; my inward parts churn. My liver is poured onto the ground at the shattering of the daughter of my people, as infant and nursing child faint in the city's squares.
verses.hebrew: כָּלוּ בַדְּמָעוֹת עֵינַי חֳמַרְמְרוּ מֵעַי נִשְׁפַּךְ לָאָרֶץ כְּבֵדִי עַל־שֶׁבֶר בַּת־עַמִּי בֵּעָטֵף עוֹלֵל וְיוֹנֵק בִּרְחֹבוֹת קִרְיָה׃

verses.english: They say to their mothers, Where are grain and wine? They faint like the wounded in the city's squares, and their lives pour out into their mothers' bosoms.
verses.hebrew: לְאִמֹּתָם יֹאמְרוּ אַיֵּה דָּגָן וָיָיִן בְּהִתְעַטְּפָם כֶּחָלָל בִּרְחֹבוֹת עִיר בְּהִשְׁתַּפֵּךְ נַפְשָׁם אֶל־חֵיק אִמֹּתָם׃

verses.english: What can I testify to you? To what can I compare you, Daughter Jerusalem? What can I set beside you to comfort you, virgin Daughter Zion? For your breaking is great as the sea; who can heal you?
verses.hebrew: מָה־אֲעִידֵךְ מָה אֲדַמֶּה־לָּךְ הַבַּת יְרוּשָׁלִַם מָה אַשְׁוֶה־לָּךְ וַאֲנַחֲמֵךְ בְּתוּלַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן כִּי־גָדוֹל כַּיָּם שִׁבְרֵךְ מִי יִרְפָּא־לָךְ׃

verses.english: Your prophets saw emptiness and foolishness for you. They did not expose your iniquity to restore your fortunes; they saw for you empty oracles and causes of banishment.
verses.hebrew: נְבִיאַיִךְ חָזוּ לָךְ שָׁוְא וְתָפֵל וְלֹא־גִלּוּ עַל־עֲוֺנֵךְ לְהָשִׁיב שביתך [שְׁבוּתֵךְ] וַיֶּחֱזוּ לָךְ מַשְׂאוֹת שָׁוְא וּמַדּוּחִים׃

verses.english: All who pass along the road clap their hands at you. They hiss and shake their heads at Daughter Jerusalem: Is this the city called perfect in beauty, the joy of all the earth?
verses.hebrew: סָפְקוּ עָלַיִךְ כַּפַּיִם כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דֶרֶךְ שָׁרְקוּ וַיָּנִעוּ רֹאשָׁם עַל־בַּת יְרוּשָׁלִָם הֲזֹאת הָעִיר שֶׁיֹּאמְרוּ כְּלִילַת יֹפִי מָשׂוֹשׂ לְכָל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth; they say, We have swallowed her! Surely this is the day we hoped for; we have found it, we have seen it!
verses.hebrew: פָּצוּ עָלַיִךְ פִּיהֶם כָּל־אוֹיְבַיִךְ שָׁרְקוּ וַיַּחַרְקוּ־שֵׁן אָמְרוּ בִּלָּעְנוּ אַךְ זֶה הַיּוֹם שֶׁקִּוִּינֻהוּ מָצָאנוּ רָאִינוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH did what He planned; He fulfilled His word, which He commanded from days of old. He tore down without pity; He made the enemy rejoice over you and exalted your adversaries' horn.
verses.hebrew: עָשָׂה יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר זָמָם בִּצַּע אֶמְרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מִימֵי־קֶדֶם הָרַס וְלֹא חָמָל וַיְשַׂמַּח עָלַיִךְ אוֹיֵב הֵרִים קֶרֶן צָרָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of Daughter Zion, let tears run down like a torrent day and night! Give yourself no respite; let the pupil of your eye not rest.
verses.hebrew: צָעַק לִבָּם אֶל־אֲדֹנָי חוֹמַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן הוֹרִידִי כַנַּחַל דִּמְעָה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה אַל־תִּתְּנִי פוּגַת לָךְ אַל־תִּדֹּם בַּת־עֵינֵךְ׃

verses.english: Rise, cry out in the night at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the Lord. Lift your hands to Him for the lives of your little ones, who faint with hunger at the head of every street.
verses.hebrew: קוּמִי רֹנִּי בליל [בַלַּיְלָה] לְרֹאשׁ אַשְׁמֻרוֹת שִׁפְכִי כַמַּיִם לִבֵּךְ נֹכַח פְּנֵי אֲדֹנָי שְׂאִי אֵלָיו כַּפַּיִךְ עַל־נֶפֶשׁ עוֹלָלַיִךְ הָעֲטוּפִים בְּרָעָב בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־חוּצוֹת׃

verses.english: See, YHWH, and look: with whom have You dealt this way? Should women eat their fruit, the little ones they have nurtured? Should priest and prophet be killed in the Lord's sanctuary?
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה יְהוָה וְהַבִּיטָה לְמִי עוֹלַלְתָּ כֹּה אִם־תֹּאכַלְנָה נָשִׁים פִּרְיָם עֹלֲלֵי טִפֻּחִים אִם־יֵהָרֵג בְּמִקְדַּשׁ אֲדֹנָי כֹּהֵן וְנָבִיא׃

verses.english: Young and old lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You killed on the day of Your anger; You slaughtered without pity.
verses.hebrew: שָׁכְבוּ לָאָרֶץ חוּצוֹת נַעַר וְזָקֵן בְּתוּלֹתַי וּבַחוּרַי נָפְלוּ בֶחָרֶב הָרַגְתָּ בְּיוֹם אַפֶּךָ טָבַחְתָּ לֹא חָמָלְתָּ׃

verses.english: You summon my terrors from all around as on a festival day. On the day of YHWH's anger there was neither escapee nor survivor. Those I nurtured and raised, my enemy consumed.
verses.hebrew: תִּקְרָא כְיוֹם מוֹעֵד מְגוּרַי מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא הָיָה בְּיוֹם אַף־יְהוָה פָּלִיט וְשָׂרִיד אֲשֶׁר־טִפַּחְתִּי וְרִבִּיתִי אֹיְבִי כִלָּם׃

verses.english: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of His fury.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי הַגֶּבֶר רָאָה עֳנִי בְּשֵׁבֶט עֶבְרָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He drove me and led me into darkness, not light.
verses.hebrew: אוֹתִי נָהַג וַיֹּלַךְ חֹשֶׁךְ וְלֹא־אוֹר׃

verses.english: Indeed, against me He turns His hand again and again all day.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ בִּי יָשֻׁב יַהֲפֹךְ יָדוֹ כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: He wore away my flesh and my skin; He broke my bones.
verses.hebrew: בִּלָּה בְשָׂרִי וְעוֹרִי שִׁבַּר עַצְמוֹתָי׃

verses.english: He built against me and surrounded me with poison and hardship.
verses.hebrew: בָּנָה עָלַי וַיַּקַּף רֹאשׁ וּתְלָאָה׃

verses.english: He made me dwell in dark places like those long dead.
verses.hebrew: בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּים הוֹשִׁיבַנִי כְּמֵתֵי עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: He walled me in so I cannot go out; He made my bronze fetters heavy.
verses.hebrew: גָּדַר בַּעֲדִי וְלֹא אֵצֵא הִכְבִּיד נְחָשְׁתִּי׃

verses.english: Even when I cry and call for help, He blocks my prayer.
verses.hebrew: גַּם כִּי אֶזְעַק וַאֲשַׁוֵּעַ שָׂתַם תְּפִלָּתִי׃

verses.english: He walled my roads with hewn stone and twisted my paths.
verses.hebrew: גָּדַר דְּרָכַי בְּגָזִית נְתִיבֹתַי עִוָּה׃

verses.english: He is a bear lying in wait for me, a lion in hiding.
verses.hebrew: דֹּב אֹרֵב הוּא לִי אריה [אֲרִי] בְּמִסְתָּרִים׃

verses.english: He turned my ways aside and tore me apart; He made me desolate.
verses.hebrew: דְּרָכַי סוֹרֵר וַיְפַשְּׁחֵנִי שָׂמַנִי שֹׁמֵם׃

verses.english: He bent His bow and set me as a target for the arrow.
verses.hebrew: דָּרַךְ קַשְׁתוֹ וַיַּצִּיבֵנִי כַּמַּטָּרָא לַחֵץ׃

verses.english: He drove the sons of His quiver into my kidneys.
verses.hebrew: הֵבִיא בְּכִלְיוֹתָי בְּנֵי אַשְׁפָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: I became a laughingstock to all my people, their song all day.
verses.hebrew: הָיִיתִי שְּׂחֹק לְכָל־עַמִּי נְגִינָתָם כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: He filled me with bitter things and drenched me with wormwood.
verses.hebrew: הִשְׂבִּיעַנִי בַמְּרוֹרִים הִרְוַנִי לַעֲנָה׃

verses.english: He ground my teeth with gravel and pressed me down in ashes.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגְרֵס בֶּחָצָץ שִׁנָּי הִכְפִּישַׁנִי בָּאֵפֶר׃

verses.english: My soul was driven away from peace; I forgot goodness.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּזְנַח מִשָּׁלוֹם נַפְשִׁי נָשִׁיתִי טוֹבָה׃

verses.english: I said, My endurance has perished, and my hope from YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אָבַד נִצְחִי וְתוֹחַלְתִּי מֵיְהוָה׃

verses.english: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and poison.
verses.hebrew: זְכָר־עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי לַעֲנָה וָרֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: My soul continually remembers and sinks down within me.
verses.hebrew: זָכוֹר תִּזְכּוֹר ותשיח [וְתָשׁוֹחַ] עָלַי נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: This I bring back to my heart; therefore I will hope.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת אָשִׁיב אֶל־לִבִּי עַל־כֵּן אוֹחִיל׃

verses.english: YHWH is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul that seeks Him.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב יְהוָה לְקוָֹו לְנֶפֶשׁ תִּדְרְשֶׁנּוּ׃

verses.english: It is good to wait quietly for YHWH's salvation.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב וְיָחִיל וְדוּמָם לִתְשׁוּעַת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: It is good for a man to bear a yoke in his youth.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב לַגֶּבֶר כִּי־יִשָּׂא עֹל בִּנְעוּרָיו׃

verses.english: Let him sit alone and be silent, for He has laid it upon him.
verses.hebrew: יֵשֵׁב בָּדָד וְיִדֹּם כִּי נָטַל עָלָיו׃

verses.english: Let him offer his cheek to the one striking him; let him be filled with reproach.
verses.hebrew: יִתֵּן לְמַכֵּהוּ לֶחִי יִשְׂבַּע בְּחֶרְפָּה׃

verses.english: For the Lord will not reject forever.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יִזְנַח לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי׃

verses.english: For though He causes grief, He will have compassion according to His abundant steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־הוֹגָה וְרִחַם כְּרֹב חסדו [חֲסָדָיו׃]

verses.english: For He does not afflict from His heart or grieve human beings.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא עִנָּה מִלִּבּוֹ וַיַּגֶּה בְנֵי־אִישׁ׃

verses.english: To crush under one's feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.hebrew: לְדַכֵּא תַּחַת רַגְלָיו כֹּל אֲסִירֵי אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: to turn aside a man's justice before the face of the Most High,
verses.hebrew: לְהַטּוֹת מִשְׁפַּט־גָּבֶר נֶגֶד פְּנֵי עֶלְיוֹן׃

verses.english: to wrong a person in his lawsuit—the Lord does not look on with approval.
verses.hebrew: לְעַוֵּת אָדָם בְּרִיבוֹ אֲדֹנָי לֹא רָאָה׃

verses.english: Who spoke and it came to be, unless the Lord commanded it?
verses.hebrew: מִי זֶה אָמַר וַתֶּהִי אֲדֹנָי לֹא צִוָּה׃

verses.english: Do not calamities and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
verses.hebrew: מִפִּי עֶלְיוֹן לֹא תֵצֵא הָרָעוֹת וְהַטּוֹב׃

verses.english: Why should a living person complain, a man concerning his sins?
verses.hebrew: מַה־יִּתְאוֹנֵן אָדָם חָי גֶּבֶר עַל־חטאו [חֲטָאָיו׃]

verses.english: Let us search and examine our ways, and return to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: נַחְפְּשָׂה דְרָכֵינוּ וְנַחְקֹרָה וְנָשׁוּבָה עַד־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Let us lift our heart with our hands to God in heaven.
verses.hebrew: נִשָּׂא לְבָבֵנוּ אֶל־כַּפָּיִם אֶל־אֵל בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: We have transgressed and rebelled; You have not forgiven.
verses.hebrew: נַחְנוּ פָשַׁעְנוּ וּמָרִינוּ אַתָּה לֹא סָלָחְתָּ׃

verses.english: You covered Yourself with anger and pursued us; You killed without pity.
verses.hebrew: סַכֹּתָה בָאַף וַתִּרְדְּפֵנוּ הָרַגְתָּ לֹא חָמָלְתָּ׃

verses.english: You covered Yourself with a cloud so that prayer could not pass through.
verses.hebrew: סַכּוֹתָה בֶעָנָן לָךְ מֵעֲבוֹר תְּפִלָּה׃

verses.english: You made us refuse and rubbish among the peoples.
verses.hebrew: סְחִי וּמָאוֹס תְּשִׂימֵנוּ בְּקֶרֶב הָעַמִּים׃

verses.english: All our enemies opened their mouths against us.
verses.hebrew: פָּצוּ עָלֵינוּ פִּיהֶם כָּל־אֹיְבֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Terror and pit have come upon us, devastation and shattering.
verses.hebrew: פַּחַד וָפַחַת הָיָה לָנוּ הַשֵּׁאת וְהַשָּׁבֶר׃

verses.english: Streams of water flow from my eye at the shattering of the daughter of my people.
verses.hebrew: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם תֵּרַד עֵינִי עַל־שֶׁבֶר בַּת־עַמִּי׃

verses.english: My eye pours out and does not cease, without respite,
verses.hebrew: עֵינִי נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תִדְמֶה מֵאֵין הֲפֻגוֹת׃

verses.english: until YHWH looks down and sees from heaven.
verses.hebrew: עַד־יַשְׁקִיף וְיֵרֶא יְהוָה מִשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: My eye causes my soul grief because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.hebrew: עֵינִי עוֹלְלָה לְנַפְשִׁי מִכֹּל בְּנוֹת עִירִי׃

verses.english: Those who were my enemies without cause hunted me down like a bird.
verses.hebrew: צוֹד צָדוּנִי כַּצִּפּוֹר אֹיְבַי חִנָּם׃

verses.english: They cut off my life in the pit and cast a stone at me.
verses.hebrew: צָמְתוּ בַבּוֹר חַיָּי וַיַּדּוּ־אֶבֶן בִּי׃

verses.english: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.
verses.hebrew: צָפוּ־מַיִם עַל־רֹאשִׁי אָמַרְתִּי נִגְזָרְתִּי׃

verses.english: I called Your name, YHWH, from the deepest pit.
verses.hebrew: קָרָאתִי שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה מִבּוֹר תַּחְתִּיּוֹת׃

verses.english: You heard my voice: Do not hide Your ear from my relief, from my cry for help.
verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי שָׁמָעְתָּ אַל־תַּעְלֵם אָזְנְךָ לְרַוְחָתִי לְשַׁוְעָתִי׃

verses.english: You drew near on the day I called You; You said, Do not fear.
verses.hebrew: קָרַבְתָּ בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָאֶךָּ אָמַרְתָּ אַל־תִּירָא׃

verses.english: You pleaded the cases of my soul, Lord; You redeemed my life.
verses.hebrew: רַבְתָּ אֲדֹנָי רִיבֵי נַפְשִׁי גָּאַלְתָּ חַיָּי׃

verses.english: You saw the wrong done to me, YHWH; judge my case.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתָה יְהוָה עַוָּתָתִי שָׁפְטָה מִשְׁפָּטִי׃

verses.english: You saw all their vengeance, all their schemes against me.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתָה כָּל־נִקְמָתָם כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָם לִי׃

verses.english: You heard their reproach, YHWH, all their schemes against me,
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתָם יְהוָה כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָם עָלָי׃

verses.english: the lips of those rising against me and their muttering against me all day.
verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי קָמַי וְהֶגְיוֹנָם עָלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: Look at their sitting and their rising; I am their mocking song.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְתָּם וְקִימָתָם הַבִּיטָה אֲנִי מַנְגִּינָתָם׃

verses.english: Repay them, YHWH, according to the work of their hands.
verses.hebrew: תָּשִׁיב לָהֶם גְּמוּל יְהוָה כְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Give them a covering of heart; let Your curse be upon them.
verses.hebrew: תִּתֵּן לָהֶם מְגִנַּת־לֵב תַּאֲלָתְךָ לָהֶם׃

verses.english: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from beneath YHWH's heavens.
verses.hebrew: תִּרְדֹּף בְּאַף וְתַשְׁמִידֵם מִתַּחַת שְׁמֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: How the gold has grown dim, how the fine gold has changed! Sacred stones are poured out at the head of every street.
verses.hebrew: אֵיכָה יוּעַם זָהָב יִשְׁנֶא הַכֶּתֶם הַטּוֹב תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי־קֹדֶשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־חוּצוֹת׃

verses.english: Zion's precious sons, weighed against refined gold— how they are regarded as earthen jars, the work of a potter's hands!
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי צִיּוֹן הַיְקָרִים הַמְסֻלָּאִים בַּפָּז אֵיכָה נֶחְשְׁבוּ לְנִבְלֵי־חֶרֶשׂ מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי יוֹצֵר׃

verses.english: Even jackals bare the breast and nurse their young; the daughter of my people has become cruel, like ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־תנין [תַּנִּים] חָלְצוּ שַׁד הֵינִיקוּ גּוּרֵיהֶן בַּת־עַמִּי לְאַכְזָר כי ענים [כַּיְעֵנִים] בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: The nursing child's tongue clings to its palate with thirst. Little ones ask for bread; no one breaks it for them.
verses.hebrew: דָּבַק לְשׁוֹן יוֹנֵק אֶל־חִכּוֹ בַּצָּמָא עוֹלָלִים שָׁאֲלוּ לֶחֶם פֹּרֵשׂ אֵין לָהֶם׃

verses.english: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets; those brought up in scarlet embrace rubbish heaps.
verses.hebrew: הָאֹכְלִים לְמַעֲדַנִּים נָשַׁמּוּ בַּחוּצוֹת הָאֱמֻנִים עֲלֵי תוֹלָע חִבְּקוּ אַשְׁפַּתּוֹת׃

verses.english: The iniquity of the daughter of my people became greater than Sodom's sin, which was overthrown in a moment, and no hands were laid upon it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל עֲוֺן בַּת־עַמִּי מֵחַטַּאת סְדֹם הַהֲפוּכָה כְמוֹ־רָגַע וְלֹא־חָלוּ בָהּ יָדָיִם׃

verses.english: Her consecrated men were purer than snow, whiter than milk; they were ruddier in body than coral, their form like sapphire.
verses.hebrew: זַכּוּ נְזִירֶיהָ מִשֶּׁלֶג צַחוּ מֵחָלָב אָדְמוּ עֶצֶם מִפְּנִינִים סַפִּיר גִּזְרָתָם׃

verses.english: Their appearance became darker than blackness; they were unrecognized in the streets. Their skin shriveled onto their bones; it dried out and became like wood.
verses.hebrew: חָשַׁךְ מִשְּׁחוֹר תָּאֳרָם לֹא נִכְּרוּ בַּחוּצוֹת צָפַד עוֹרָם עַל־עַצְמָם יָבֵשׁ הָיָה כָעֵץ׃

verses.english: Those slain by the sword were better off than those slain by hunger, who waste away, pierced through for lack of the field's produce.
verses.hebrew: טוֹבִים הָיוּ חַלְלֵי־חֶרֶב מֵחַלְלֵי רָעָב שֶׁהֵם יָזוּבוּ מְדֻקָּרִים מִתְּנוּבֹת שָׂדָי׃

verses.english: The hands of compassionate women cooked their children; they became food for them at the shattering of the daughter of my people.
verses.hebrew: יְדֵי נָשִׁים רַחֲמָנִיּוֹת בִּשְּׁלוּ יַלְדֵיהֶן הָיוּ לְבָרוֹת לָמוֹ בְּשֶׁבֶר בַּת־עַמִּי׃

verses.english: YHWH exhausted His wrath and poured out His burning anger. He kindled a fire in Zion, and it consumed her foundations.
verses.hebrew: כִּלָּה יְהוָה אֶת־חֲמָתוֹ שָׁפַךְ חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וַיַּצֶּת־אֵשׁ בְּצִיּוֹן וַתֹּאכַל יְסוֹדֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: The kings of the earth and all who dwell in the world did not believe that adversary and enemy would enter Jerusalem's gates.
verses.hebrew: לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ מַלְכֵי־אֶרֶץ וכל [כֹּל] יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי יָבֹא צַר וְאוֹיֵב בְּשַׁעֲרֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: It was because of her prophets' sins and her priests' iniquities, those who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst.
verses.hebrew: מֵחַטֹּאת נְבִיאֶיהָ עֲוֺנוֹת כֹּהֲנֶיהָ הַשֹּׁפְכִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ דַּם צַדִּיקִים׃

verses.english: They wandered blindly in the streets, polluted with blood, so that no one could touch their garments.
verses.hebrew: נָעוּ עִוְרִים בַּחוּצוֹת נְגֹאֲלוּ בַּדָּם בְּלֹא יוּכְלוּ יִגְּעוּ בִּלְבֻשֵׁיהֶם׃

verses.english: Away! Unclean! they cried to them. Away, away! Do not touch! They fled and wandered; among the nations people said, They shall stay here no longer.
verses.hebrew: סוּרוּ טָמֵא קָרְאוּ לָמוֹ סוּרוּ סוּרוּ אַל־תִּגָּעוּ כִּי נָצוּ גַּם־נָעוּ אָמְרוּ בַּגּוֹיִם לֹא יוֹסִיפוּ לָגוּר׃

verses.english: YHWH's face scattered them; He will look upon them no longer. They showed no respect to priests and no favor to elders.
verses.hebrew: פְּנֵי יְהוָה חִלְּקָם לֹא יוֹסִיף לְהַבִּיטָם פְּנֵי כֹהֲנִים לֹא נָשָׂאוּ זקנים [וּזְקֵנִים] לֹא חָנָנוּ׃

verses.english: Still our eyes failed, looking for our help in vain. From our lookout we watched for a nation that could not save.
verses.hebrew: עודינה [עוֹדֵינוּ] תִּכְלֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ אֶל־עֶזְרָתֵנוּ הָבֶל בְּצִפִּיָּתֵנוּ צִפִּינוּ אֶל־גּוֹי לֹא יוֹשִׁעַ׃

verses.english: They hunted our steps so we could not walk in our squares. Our end drew near, our days were fulfilled, for our end had come.
verses.hebrew: צָדוּ צְעָדֵינוּ מִלֶּכֶת בִּרְחֹבֹתֵינוּ קָרַב קִצֵּינוּ מָלְאוּ יָמֵינוּ כִּי־בָא קִצֵּינוּ׃

verses.english: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens. They chased us upon the mountains and lay in wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: קַלִּים הָיוּ רֹדְפֵינוּ מִנִּשְׁרֵי שָׁמָיִם עַל־הֶהָרִים דְּלָקֻנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר אָרְבוּ לָנוּ׃

verses.english: The breath of our nostrils, YHWH's anointed, was caught in their pits, of whom we said, In his shadow we will live among the nations.
verses.hebrew: רוּחַ אַפֵּינוּ מְשִׁיחַ יְהוָה נִלְכַּד בִּשְׁחִיתוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְנוּ בְּצִלּוֹ נִחְיֶה בַגּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Edom, dwelling in the land of Uz! To you too the cup will pass; you will become drunk and strip yourself bare.
verses.hebrew: שִׂישִׂי וְשִׂמְחִי בַּת־אֱדוֹם יושבתי [יוֹשֶׁבֶת] בְּאֶרֶץ עוּץ גַּם־עָלַיִךְ תַּעֲבָר־כּוֹס תִּשְׁכְּרִי וְתִתְעָרִי׃

verses.english: Your iniquity has come to an end, Daughter Zion; He will exile you no longer. He has visited your iniquity, Daughter Edom; He has exposed your sins.
verses.hebrew: תַּם־עֲוֺנֵךְ בַּת־צִיּוֹן לֹא יוֹסִיף לְהַגְלוֹתֵךְ פָּקַד עֲוֺנֵךְ בַּת־אֱדוֹם גִּלָּה עַל־חַטֹּאתָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Remember, YHWH, what has happened to us; look and see our reproach.
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר יְהוָה מֶה־הָיָה לָנוּ הביט [הַבִּיטָה] וּרְאֵה אֶת־חֶרְפָּתֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Our inheritance has passed to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
verses.hebrew: נַחֲלָתֵנוּ נֶהֶפְכָה לְזָרִים בָּתֵּינוּ לְנָכְרִים׃

verses.english: We have become orphans, fatherless; our mothers are like widows.
verses.hebrew: יְתוֹמִים הָיִינוּ אין [וְאֵין] אָב אִמֹּתֵינוּ כְּאַלְמָנוֹת׃

verses.english: We drink our water for money; our wood comes at a price.
verses.hebrew: מֵימֵינוּ בְּכֶסֶף שָׁתִינוּ עֵצֵינוּ בִּמְחִיר יָבֹאוּ׃

verses.english: We are pursued at our necks; we are weary and are given no rest.
verses.hebrew: עַל צַוָּארֵנוּ נִרְדָּפְנוּ יָגַעְנוּ לא [וְלֹא] הוּנַח לָנוּ׃

verses.english: We gave a hand to Egypt, to Assyria, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.hebrew: מִצְרַיִם נָתַנּוּ יָד אַשּׁוּר לִשְׂבֹּעַ לָחֶם׃

verses.english: Our fathers sinned and are no more; we bear their iniquities.
verses.hebrew: אֲבֹתֵינוּ חָטְאוּ אינם [וְאֵינָם] אנחנו [וַאֲנַחְנוּ] עֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶם סָבָלְנוּ׃

verses.english: Slaves rule over us; no one rescues us from their hand.
verses.hebrew: עֲבָדִים מָשְׁלוּ בָנוּ פֹּרֵק אֵין מִיָּדָם׃

verses.english: At the risk of our lives we bring in our bread, because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: בְּנַפְשֵׁנוּ נָבִיא לַחְמֵנוּ מִפְּנֵי חֶרֶב הַמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: Our skin burns like an oven because of hunger's scorching blasts.
verses.hebrew: עוֹרֵנוּ כְּתַנּוּר נִכְמָרוּ מִפְּנֵי זַלְעֲפוֹת רָעָב׃

verses.english: They violated women in Zion, virgins in Judah's cities.
verses.hebrew: נָשִׁים בְּצִיּוֹן עִנּוּ בְּתֻלֹת בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: Princes were hung by their hands; elders were not honored.
verses.hebrew: שָׂרִים בְּיָדָם נִתְלוּ פְּנֵי זְקֵנִים לֹא נֶהְדָּרוּ׃

verses.english: Young men carry the millstone, and boys stumble under wood.
verses.hebrew: בַּחוּרִים טְחוֹן נָשָׂאוּ וּנְעָרִים בָּעֵץ כָּשָׁלוּ׃

verses.english: Elders have ceased from the gate, young men from their music.
verses.hebrew: זְקֵנִים מִשַּׁעַר שָׁבָתוּ בַּחוּרִים מִנְּגִינָתָם׃

verses.english: The joy of our heart has ceased; our dancing has turned to mourning.
verses.hebrew: שָׁבַת מְשׂוֹשׂ לִבֵּנוּ נֶהְפַּךְ לְאֵבֶל מְחֹלֵנוּ׃

verses.english: The crown has fallen from our head; woe to us, for we have sinned!
verses.hebrew: נָפְלָה עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשֵׁנוּ אוֹי־נָא לָנוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ׃

verses.english: For this our heart has become faint; for these things our eyes have grown dim,
verses.hebrew: עַל־זֶה הָיָה דָוֶה לִבֵּנוּ עַל־אֵלֶּה חָשְׁכוּ עֵינֵינוּ׃

verses.english: because Mount Zion is desolate; foxes walk upon it.
verses.hebrew: עַל הַר־צִיּוֹן שֶׁשָּׁמֵם שׁוּעָלִים הִלְּכוּ־בוֹ׃

verses.english: You, YHWH, are enthroned forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב כִּסְאֲךָ לְדֹר וָדוֹר׃

verses.english: Why do You forget us forever and forsake us for so many days?
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה לָנֶצַח תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ תַּעַזְבֵנוּ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃

verses.english: Turn us back to You, YHWH, and we will return; renew our days as of old.
verses.hebrew: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ ונשוב [וְנָשׁוּבָה] חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם׃

verses.english: Unless You have utterly rejected us and are exceedingly angry with us.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־מָאֹס מְאַסְתָּנוּ קָצַפְתָּ עָלֵינוּ עַד־מְאֹד׃[השיבנו יהוה אליך ונשובה חדש ימינו כקדם]
